item.title: Kichijouji Escalation Yard
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hammerheads
  • 発売日: 2004-04-02
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 吉祥寺エスカレーションヤード
  • 英語名: Kichijouji Escalation Yard

あらすじ

The protagonist “Kou”, who was born and raised in Kichijoji, unwillingly spends his days working in a woman’s specialty underwear shop.

One day, a chain of bizarre murders occur in the streets of Kichijoji. Every week, a new girl will be kidnapped and raped before being murdered, in an event that has become known as the “Moth of Wednesday”… Eventually, the incident also starts to involve the girls surrounding Kou. “Yeah, I’ll protect you! I promise…” But in order to fulfill that promise and to regain peace in your hometown of Kichijoji, he must safely rescue the abducted girls by following the footsteps of the murderers by inspecting the murder scenes and tracking them down.
